# results

Individual scan results.

- Toolset name: `results`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 2 (2 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_get_result`

**Get result** · read-only

Get one scan result by UUID, including the full finding description and NVT reference.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_list_results`

**List results** · read-only

List individual scan results (findings) across reports. Supports GMP filter expressions like `severity>7 and host=10.0.0.5`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |
